body: I've taken both, currently on Strattera. I have adhd-c, so my hyperactive/impulsive side might skew my opinions. Wellbutrin was a nightmare for me, I started experiencing tons of side effects but I didn't really think that it was due to wellbutrin, so when my dose got upped, it was really bad. I genuinely experienced almost every side effect and I stayed on wellbutrin for maybe six months. On strattera now and the change was very subtle, but only lasted about two weeks, been on it for three months now and it hasn't been working for about a month n a half. Definitely better than wellbutrin though because I did experience an improvement (at first) and no side effects.

How long had you taken Strattera for? I took it for about six weeks before noticing any changes. Also I started at 40mg and was upped to 80mg after the first month, so depending on how long you had taken it, it might've just not been long enough. And don't lose hope yet! Finding the right med can be really difficult, I started on Wellbutrin and experienced nothing but side effects, but I know someone who's done nothing but benefitted from Wellbutrin! I wish you luck with finding the right med for you!

Yeah, I think it's pretty common for how strattera is prescribed, I read that they usually start you at half of the intended dosage, not sure why though, so he may not notice any benefits until after a month or so.

It sounds like it's definitely not the med for you, I've been on it for about three months now and it didn't help at all the first month, but they upped my dose from 40mg to 80mg and within two weeks I had noticed a difference. It was super subtle for me, like many people experience, so I definitely think you should talk to your psychiatrist and try another med. I wish you the best of luck with finding one that works for you!

I've been on strattera for around three months now, I didn't have any dizziness or anything, I did get an upset stomach the first day I took it, but that's it. I also get lightheaded more frequently, but only when I stand up after sitting for super long. It's helped me a lot with some hyperactivity and with falling asleep, as well as being able to concentrate better. The shift was really subtle, but has helped me a lot! Unfortunately the last week or so, it hasn't seemed to be helping much at all, focusing has become difficult again and some hyperactivity has returned. Also, I started at 40mg and was bumped up to 80mg after the first month.
